subject: general
question: From which book is the national song of India compiled?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anand Math**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The national song of India, **"Vande Mataram,"** is taken from the book **Anand Math**.
 
• **Anand Math** is a Bengali novel written by **Bankim Chandra Chatterjee**.
 
• The song **"Vande Mataram"** was written in Sanskrit and Bengali.
 
• It played a vital role in the Indian independence movement and was first sung by **Rabindranath Tagore** in 1896.
 
• The novel **Anand Math** was published in 1882 and is set in the background of the Sannyasi Rebellion in the late 18th century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **national song** status was conferred on "Vande Mataram" by the Constituent Assembly of India on 24 January 1950.
 
• **Bankim Chandra Chatterjee** was one of the earliest graduates of the University of Calcutta and a prominent figure in the literary renaissance of Bengal.
 
• The song is known for its patriotic fervor and has been a source of inspiration for many freedom fighters.
 
• It consists of six stanzas, but usually, only the first two are sung during official events.
 
• The song's lyrics praise the motherland and evoke a sense of devotion and pride among the citizens of India.
